title: forward_backward_pipelining_with_interleaving uses num_microbatches instead of total_num_microbatches in the param-sync gate
root_cause: Condition `param_sync_microbatch_id < num_microbatches` should be `< total_num_microbatches`; only first num_microbatches param-syncs were aligned across PP ranks.
invariant: param_sync_func should be invoked the same number of times whether the gate uses num_microbatches or total_num_microbatches when total = num*num_chunks > num

expected_output.buggy: BUG DETECTED: param_sync_func called fewer times than the fixed branch
expected_output.fixed: CLEAN: param_sync_func call count matches expected
